task.coordinate_convention: Path and time changes are magnitudes because the stage-motion sense was not given; required mechanical travel is nonnegative.

questions.request: Find the change in optical path length.
Find the change in time delay.
Estimate the required one-way mechanical travel for a 150 ps delay scan.

task.statement: An ultrashort pulse enters a straight folded delay line with two reflections. The translation stage carrying the retroreflecting mirror group moves 1.4 mm along the optical axis. The beam traverses the moving-stage gap once on the outbound leg and once on the return leg; no other moving path segment changes. Report changes in optical path and time delay as magnitudes.
